title: Parse rate-limit headers
hints: Write a helper that finds a header by comparing key.lower() to the wanted name, returning None when absent.
Write a second helper: try float(text.strip()) and return None on ValueError. Both fields then become one-liners.
Order matters for reset_in: check Retry-After first; else max(0.0, reset - now); else None.
wait_seconds: if Retry-After is present or remaining <= 0 return reset_in or 0.0, else 0.0.
